label: <DEL> step of maximum-length (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires almost only at t=8-9, mainly on the <DEL> delimiter of long sequences. 88% of activation mass is on the delimiter step: 52% of L=9 delimiters and about 10% of L=8 delimiters fire, and it never fires for L<=6. A further ~10% of mass is on the last original token (t=8) of L=9 sequences, the step just before <DEL>. A trace remains on the first copy steps. Magnitude is highest on L=9 delimiters. Whether a given L=9 delimiter fires depends on sequence content in a way that is not easily captured: the last token being e/v/j/u/n raises the rate, but token-set predicates did not improve F1. Essentially silent during the original phase before t=7 and through most of the copy phase. Best alternative is (phase==1)&(L>=8): mass recall 0.88 but precision 0.32.
